Expect val_ssim that does NOT clear the FBP baseline (hr near 0). This iter ESTABLISHES that datapoint on the redone split under the frozen metric -- a real, valid finding (do NOT reduce val_n further or inflate to make NAF look better; hr=0 plateau documents the ceiling for paper section 5.4).
